full_prompt_en: A square color photograph frames a young girl from a low, intimate angle, her face filling most of the image against a red patterned interior background. The picture cuts close at the top of her hair and near the upper chest, leaving only narrow strips of surroundings. Behind her, a dark red surface carries large, softly blurred cream and olive shapes that resemble floral decoration. A red upholstered shape enters at the right edge, adding another warm area near her cheek. The girl has fair warm skin and dark brown hair parted near the center, drawn back above the temples and curling beside both ears. A small dangling earring catches a pale point of light on the left side. Her head tilts slightly back and to the side, and she looks down toward the camera with half-lowered eyelids. The low viewpoint makes her chin and lower face prominent, while the line of the forehead recedes gently upward. Her mouth remains closed and relaxed, with soft pink lips. Her expression is composed and watchful rather than broadly smiling. Along the lower edge, a white ruffled neckline breaks against a red garment. At the lower right, a cluster of tiny reflective ornaments rests on the red fabric. The garment and upholstery share related warm reds, while the pale skin and white collar provide the strongest lighter areas. Shadows around the hair, neck, and the background pattern keep the close frame layered without making the features harsh. The photograph has a muted, slightly grainy surface and natural tonal transitions rather than polished studio retouching. Soft warm light comes from the upper right of the frame, brightening the forehead, nose, and cheek and leaving the opposite hair and background deeper. There is no readable text. The overall composition turns a candid close viewpoint and richly colored domestic backdrop into a quiet, direct study of gaze, texture, and warm interior light.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形彩色照片：镜头从低处近距离拍摄一名小女孩，她的脸占据画面大部分区域，背后是红色花纹的室内背景。画框在头发顶部和上胸附近紧紧截断，只留下狭窄的环境边条。她身后的暗红色表面带有大块柔焦的奶油色与橄榄色形状，看起来像花卉装饰。一个红色软包形体从右边缘进入，在脸颊旁增添另一块暖色。女孩肤色浅而偏暖，深褐头发在靠近中央处分开，太阳穴以上向后梳，双耳旁有卷曲发束。画面左侧，一枚小小垂饰耳环接住浅色亮点。她的头微向后和一侧倾斜，半垂眼睑朝下看向相机。低视点使下巴和下半张脸突出，额头轮廓则柔和地向上退去。嘴巴放松地闭着，嘴唇带柔粉色。神情镇定而留意周围，并非大笑。下边缘，白色褶边领口从红色衣服前显露。右下方，一簇微小的反光饰物贴在红色布料上。衣服与软包共享相近暖红色，浅肤色和白领提供最强的亮色区域。头发、脖颈和背景纹样周围的阴影让紧凑画面保持层次，却没有让五官显得生硬。照片表面低调、稍带颗粒，明暗自然过渡，而非光洁的影棚修饰。柔和暖光从画面右上方进入，照亮额头、鼻梁与脸颊，让另一侧头发和背景更深。画中没有可读文字。整体构图把随性的近距离低视点和浓郁的室内背景结合，成为关于目光、质地与暖色室内光线的安静直观的画面。
style_prompt_en: Color photography uses close, slightly low viewpoints and a warm, lived-in palette to bring surface and expression forward. Rich reds and earthy patterned midtones surround softer pale areas, with small white and reflective accents breaking the warmth. Depth stays shallow: background decoration remains readable as color and rhythm while its exact edges soften behind the sharper focal plane. Gentle grain and unpolished tonal transitions preserve a candid quality. Warm side light shapes the central forms naturally, allowing dark edges and recesses to give the close framing depth. The overall visual character is intimate and observant, with bold domestic color held in check by soft focus and restrained illumination.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色摄影采用近距离、略低的视点和带生活气息的暖色调，把表面与神情推向前方。浓郁红色及大地色纹样中间调围绕较柔软的浅色区域，少量白色和反光重点打破暖色包围。景深较浅：背景装饰作为色彩与节奏仍可辨认，确切边缘却在较清晰的焦平面之后柔化。轻微颗粒与未经抛光的明暗过渡保留随拍感。暖侧光自然塑造中央形体，深色边缘和凹处为紧凑画框提供纵深。整体视觉气质亲密而善于观察，鲜明的室内色彩由柔焦与克制的照明调和。
theme_en: A low-angle close color portrait of a girl against a red patterned interior
theme_zh: 红色纹样室内背景前，小女孩的低视角彩色特写
name: Tina Barney
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
